title: Second order systems on Hilbert spaces with nonlinear damping
summary: We investigate a special class of nonlinear infinite dimensional systems. These systems are obtained by modifying the second order differential equation that is part of the description of conservative linear systems out of thin air introduced by M. Tucsnak and G. Weiss in 2003. The modified differential equation contains a new nonlinear damping term, that is maximal monotone and possibly set-valued.
